phases.name: Play the season, matchday by matchday

steps.name: Next matchday recording, latest-match screen and re-show test amendments
criteria: Each Play match from a known club's home appends the 4 results of the next matchday (highest recorded matchday + 1, 1 when none); earlier entries stay the identical objects
The match screen shows the managed club's fixture of the latest recorded matchday, with the h1 reading Matchday N, instead of re-showing matchday 1
Play match after matchday 14, or off a known club's home, returns the very same state and never throws; NewGame still clears the results
Formation and Starting XI picks made between matches change nothing recorded and count from the next match on
The held-out season-progression, season-end and season-for-a-club specs are moved into tests/acceptance/S-008/ and pass; the first Play match of a new game is still matchday 1
The 11 superseded S-006/S-007 re-show assertions (upstream-issues U-1 rows 1-11) are replaced, not weakened, in the same commit; ci:lint, ci:typecheck, ci:test and ci:e2e are green
steps.scenario_name: Second Play match: first four entries the very same objects, next four matchday 2, screen reads Rushmoor Heath Albion 2–1 Netherwold Borough

steps.name: Season over line on the club home after matchday 14
criteria: After matchday 14 the club home shows the plain text Season over (no heading, no button) in the Play match slot and no button named Play match
Squad, Tactics, Starting XI and Table stay on the club home, each 44px or taller; Table still reads P 14 on every row
The club-name h1 is focused on arrival and nothing in the renderer moves focus; no sideways scroll at 390px and no console errors
A whole seed-31 season in 28 taps plays Matchday 1 to Matchday 14 and matches the reference season, final table included
The held-out S-008-season e2e spec is moved into tests/e2e/; ci:e2e and tests/protected S-001..S-008 pass; season-reference.ts is kept and distill/pending/ is removed
steps.scenario_name: Whole season at ?seed=31 in 28 taps: Matchday 1..14, Season over, final table cell for cell
